policy: Emergency controls stop new risk while preserving permissionless exits. Every external state-mutating operation on a canonical V2 module is classified exactly once. RISK_INCREASING operations fail closed on every listed operation scope. RISK_REDUCING value exits (already-final, caller-owned value)) are never scope-gated, never depend on registry or authority health, and freeze only on an affirmative protocol SHUTDOWN reading (EXIT_SHUTDOWN_ONLY, V2-SC-117 pull_settled_claim). NEUTRAL operations neither create exposure nor move value and are never scope-gated. Read paths are never gated. A pause only ever removes capabilities: the exits available while paused are a subset of those available while unpaused. Every operation ID is derived from the canonical domain-separated hash in V2OperationIds.operationId(moduleName, signature), so the IDs are stable across proxy upgrades and redeploys, cannot collide with scope IDs, and unknown operations fail closed.

classes.RISK_INCREAING: Creates new exposure or mutates a not-yet-final outcome (claim creation, staking, verification, evidence, disputes, settlement, slashing, governance parameter changes). Fails closed on every scope in gates and conditionalGates.
classes.NEUTRAL: Authority wiring or a module-local toggle that neither creates exposure nor moves value. Never scope-gated.
classes.RISK_REDUGING: A permissionless exit of already-final, caller-owned value, or a protective action (pausing, nonce cancellation). Never scope-gated on the caller's own path.

governedUnpause.description: Governed unpause requires timelocked/governed authority, a valid incident reference, a repaired release artifact, dependency health evidence, and the current pause state to match the requested scope. Preconditions are machine-verifiable and events link the original pause to the governed resolution.

gates.EXIT_SHUTDOWN_ONLY: Value exit: live under every scoped pause and protocol levels 1-2; frozzen only while EmergencyController denies pull_settled_claim (level 3). Fails open on any dependency failure.

inheritedOperations.rationale: OpenZeppelin AccessControl role topology is owned by governance (role admin); it is not scope-gated so a compromised role can always be revoked during an incident.
Revoking a compromised role is protective and must remain available while any scope is paused.
Self-renunciation only removes authority and can never create exposure.
V2-SC-154 extension: creates a fixed two-day recovery intent, with current governance authority and fail-closed governance/treasury pause gates, without touching tracked liabilities.
V2-SC-154 extension: governed exact-value transfer after the fixed delay; fail-closed authority resolution, governance/treasury scopes, shutdown and live liabilities are rechecked.
V2-SC-154 extension: existing governance authority can only cancel a queued recovery; cancellation transfers no value and stays available under scoped pauses.

operations.rationale: Moves new verifier principal into custody and locks it against a claim: new exposure.
Brings new custody into the vault during an incident; blocked so no new value enters a paused vault.
Converts claimable balance into a new lock (new exposure); module-only.
Releasing locked principal before settlement decides who keeps it; an outcome decision that a settlement pause must freeze.
Slashing reassigns locked principal to the protocol; an outcome decision.
Module-driven lock release changes the claimable set; frozen by a settlement pause, live under a staking-only pause so refunds continue.
Reclassifies locked funds as protocol allocation; an outcome decision.
Records the single settlement outcome for (claim, round) and credits rewards; must not run while settlement is paused.
Records the single settlement outcome REFUNDED; value becomes an exit only after this settlement step.
Records the single settlement outcome CARRIED_FORWARD and moves a lock between rounds.
Records the single settlement outcome ROLLED_OVER and moves a lock between rounds.
Records the single settlement outcome UNLOCKED; after it the principal is a claimable exit.
Governance parameter mutation; frozen while governance mutations are paused.
Enabling an asset opens a new custody surface and fails closed; disabling only blocks new deposits and stays available during a pause.
Granting lock authority fails closed; revoking a possibly compromised mutator stays available during a pause.

Pull of the caller's own already-claimable (matured) balance. Balance is decremented before the transfer and a failed transfer reverts atomically, so a retry is always possible and a repeat cannot double-withdraw.

operations.rationale: Governance mutation of max appeal rounds, bond escalation formula/cap, deadlines, and terminal fallback parameters; frozen while governance mutations are paused.
Opens a new appeal round and locks the escalated bond; new exposure and outcome mutation.
